tocEmpty: Open a document to see its outline here.
how1: Open a .md file, or drag and drop it onto this window.
how2: Ctrl+S saves — in place on supporting browsers, otherwise as a download.
how3: Your file never leaves this browser — nothing is uploaded.
promoLead: Open whole folders, search everything, roll back any version.
promo3: Highlighter pens · canvas · AI agent bridge
getApp: Get the desktop app on Microsoft Store
desktopOnlyFolder: Opening folders, workspaces and global search are features of the Windows desktop app. The web edition opens, reads and edits one file at a time.
emptyHint: Open a file or drop it onto this window. Nothing is uploaded.
desktopFeatures: The agent bridge, highlighter pens and custom themes are in the desktop app.
themeHint: Custom theme files (.jsonc) are a desktop-app feature.
openUrlTitle: Open a Markdown file from a link (raw file, GitHub or GitLab page)
urlInvalid: That doesn't look like a web address. Paste a full link such as https://github.com/owner/repo/blob/main/README.md.
urlProtocol: Only https:// links can be opened.
urlNetwork: The browser couldn't read this address. Most often the server doesn't allow other sites to read its files (CORS), or you're offline. For GitHub, use the file's page or raw link; otherwise download the file and drop it here.
urlHttp: The server answered {{status}}. Check that the link points to a file that exists and is public.
urlTooLarge: That file is larger than 5 MB — too big to open from a link. Download it and drop it here instead.
urlHtml: That address returns a web page, not a Markdown file. Use the raw file link (on GitHub: the Raw button).
urlTimeout: The server took too long to answer. Try again, or download the file and drop it here.
shareCopied: Copied. Anyone with the link opens this document in their own browser — it is inside the link and never stored on a server ({{count}} characters).
shareManual: Copy the link below. The document is inside the link and never stored on a server ({{count}} characters).
shareTooLong: This document is too long for a link: {{length}} characters after compression, the limit is {{max}}. Send the file itself instead (Save, or Export to HTML).
shareUnsupported: This browser can't compress documents for links. Use a recent Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
shareCorrupt: This share link is incomplete or damaged — part of it was probably cut off while copying. Ask for the link again or for the file.
restoreFail: Couldn't keep your unsaved edits while switching language, so the language was not changed. Save first, then switch.
